en: A black‑and‑white postcard view of a hillside town with trees and paths in the foreground and a cluster of multi‑storey buildings and houses on the ridge above. The architecture looks early 20th‑century Central European, with steep roofs and dormer windows. In the distant right stands a round tower‑like building. There is a printed caption along the bottom edge and a red handwritten archive number in the upper right corner.
